mapper.sql: vtfd.id, vtfd.create_user_id, vtfd.create_user_name, vtfd.create_time, vtfd.update_user_id, vtfd.update_user_name, vtfd.update_time, vtfd.version, vtfd.is_deleted, vtfd.qty, vtfd.cur_inventory_qty, vtfd.virtual_trans_flow_id, vtfd.virtual_inventory_detail_id, vtfd.trade_time
mapper.select: select sum(qty) as virtualDetailQty from virtual_trans_flow_detail where is_deleted = false and virtual_inventory_detail_id = #{virtualInvDetailId} and #{startDate} > bill_date group by virtual_inventory_detail_id

select * from ( WITH virtualInventoryDetailHis AS ( select vid.sku_id, vid.warehouse_id, vid.virtual_warehouse_id, sum(vidh.wait_qty * vidh.inventory_age_days) as backInventoryAgeQty, sum(vidh.qty * vidh.inventory_age_days) as inventoryAgeQty from virtual_inventory_detail_his vidh left join virtual_inventory_detail vid on vidh.virtual_inventory_detail_id = vid.id and vid.is_deleted = false where vidh.is_deleted = false and vidh.date = CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' group by vid.sku_id,vid.warehouse_id,vid.virtual_warehouse_id ),VirtualInventoryHis AS ( SELECT vi.sku_id, vi.warehouse_id, vi.virtual_warehouse_id, SUM(vih.qty) AS virtualQty, SUM(CASE WHEN vi.dict_inventory_status = 'usable' THEN vih.qty ELSE 0 END) AS virtualUsableQty, SUM(CASE WHEN vi.dict_inventory_status = 'frozen' THEN vih.qty ELSE 0 END) AS virtualFrozenQty FROM virtual_inventory_his vih left join virtual_inventory vi on vih.virtual_inventory_id = vi.id and vi.is_deleted = false WHERE vih.is_deleted = false and vih.date = CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY vi.sku_id, vi.warehouse_id, vi.virtual_warehouse_id ),CombinedProcessing AS ( SELECT sku_id, warehouse_id, virtual_warehouse_id, SUM(frozen_qty) AS frozenQty FROM ( SELECT sku_id,warehouse_id,virtual_warehouse_id,frozen_qty FROM first_mile_processing WHERE is_deleted = false UNION ALL SELECT sku_id,warehouse_id,virtual_warehouse_id,frozen_qty FROM so_b2b_processing WHERE is_deleted = false UNION ALL SELECT sku_id,warehouse_id,virtual_warehouse_id,frozen_qty FROM so_b2c_processing WHERE is_deleted = false ) AS combined GROUP BY sku_id, warehouse_id, virtual_warehouse_id ) select vidh.sku_id as skuId, pd.sku_no as skuNo, vidh.warehouse_id as warehouseId, wh."name" as warehouseName, vidh.virtual_warehouse_id as virtualWarehouseId, vw.code as virtualWarehouseCode, vw.name as virtualWarehouseName, vih.virtualFrozenQty, COALESCE(cp.frozenQty,0) as billFrozenQty, case when vih.virtualFrozenQty = COALESCE(cp.frozenQty,0) then false else true end as frozenIsDiff from virtualInventoryDetailHis vidh left join VirtualInventoryHis vih on vidh.sku_id = vih.sku_id and vidh.warehouse_id = vih.warehouse_id and vidh.virtual_warehouse_id = vih.virtual_warehouse_id left join CombinedProcessing cp on vidh.sku_id = cp.sku_id and vidh.warehouse_id = cp.warehouse_id and vidh.virtual_warehouse_id = cp.virtual_warehouse_id left join product_detail pd on vidh.sku_id = pd.id and pd.is_deleted = false left join warehouse wh on vidh.warehouse_id = wh.id and wh.is_deleted = false left join virtual_warehouse vw on vidh.virtual_warehouse_id = vw.id and vw.is_deleted = false ) as all_data where frozenIsDiff = true

select * from ( WITH virtualInventoryDetailHis AS ( select vid.sku_id, vid.virtual_warehouse_id, sum(vidh.wait_qty * vidh.inventory_age_days) as backInventoryAgeQty, sum(vidh.qty * vidh.inventory_age_days) as inventoryAgeQty from virtual_inventory_detail_his vidh left join virtual_inventory_detail vid on vidh.virtual_inventory_detail_id = vid.id and vid.is_deleted = false where vidh.is_deleted = false and vidh.date = CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' group by vid.sku_id,vid.virtual_warehouse_id ),VirtualInventoryHis AS ( SELECT vi.sku_id, vi.virtual_warehouse_id, SUM(vih.qty) AS virtualQty, SUM(CASE WHEN vi.dict_inventory_status = 'usable' THEN vih.qty ELSE 0 END) AS virtualUsableQty, SUM(CASE WHEN vi.dict_inventory_status = 'frozen' THEN vih.qty ELSE 0 END) AS virtualFrozenQty FROM virtual_inventory_his vih left join virtual_inventory vi on vih.virtual_inventory_id = vi.id and vi.is_deleted = false WHERE vih.is_deleted = false and vih.date = CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY vi.sku_id, vi.virtual_warehouse_id ),CombinedProcessing AS ( SELECT sku_id, virtual_warehouse_id, SUM(frozen_qty) AS frozenQty FROM ( SELECT sku_id,warehouse_id,virtual_warehouse_id,frozen_qty FROM first_mile_processing WHERE is_deleted = false UNION ALL SELECT sku_id,warehouse_id,virtual_warehouse_id,frozen_qty FROM so_b2b_processing WHERE is_deleted = false UNION ALL SELECT sku_id,warehouse_id,virtual_warehouse_id,frozen_qty FROM so_b2c_processing WHERE is_deleted = false ) AS combined GROUP BY sku_id, virtual_warehouse_id ) select vidh.sku_id as skuId, pd.sku_no as skuNo, vidh.virtual_warehouse_id as virtualWarehouseId, vw.code as virtualWarehouseCode, vw.name as virtualWarehouseName, vih.virtualFrozenQty, COALESCE(cp.frozenQty,0) as billFrozenQty, case when vih.virtualFrozenQty = COALESCE(cp.frozenQty,0) then false else true end as frozenIsDiff from virtualInventoryDetailHis vidh left join VirtualInventoryHis vih on vidh.sku_id = vih.sku_id and vidh.virtual_warehouse_id = vih.virtual_warehouse_id left join CombinedProcessing cp on vidh.sku_id = cp.sku_id and vidh.virtual_warehouse_id = cp.virtual_warehouse_id left join product_detail pd on vidh.sku_id = pd.id and pd.is_deleted = false left join virtual_warehouse vw on vidh.virtual_warehouse_id = vw.id and vw.is_deleted = false ) as all_data where frozenIsDiff = true
